# Proper Electric

> Licensed, insured electrician serving Chicago and the surrounding suburbs (Cook, DuPage & Lake counties). Family-owned, founded 2010. Specializes in EV charger installation, smart home lighting, panel upgrades, and residential/commercial electrical work.

Phone: (847) 744-4625
Email: properelectric@gmail.com
License: IL-EC-00000 (licensed, bonded, insured)
Hours: Mon–Sat 7am–7pm, 24/7 emergency service
Service area: Chicago, Evanston, Oak Park, Naperville, Skokie, Schaumburg, Arlington Heights, Wilmette, Hinsdale, Glenview, Lincolnwood, Northbrook

## Services

- [EV Charger Installation](https://theproperelectric.com/services/ev-charger-installation.html): Tesla Wall Connector, ChargePoint, and universal Level 2 charger installs. Typical cost $600–$1,800. Includes permit filing, inspection, and rebate paperwork (federal tax credit up to $7,500, Illinois EV rebate up to $1,500, ComEd incentive up to $1,000).
- [Smart Home Lighting](https://theproperelectric.com/services/smart-home-lighting.html): Whole-home lighting control via Alexa, Google Home, or Lutron Caséta/RA3.
- [Recessed & Designer Lighting](https://theproperelectric.com/services/recessed-lighting.html): Architectural lighting layout, recessed can installation, LED retrofit, dimming.
- [Panel Upgrades](https://theproperelectric.com/services/panel-upgrades.html): 100A to 200A+ electrical service upgrades, fuse box replacement, code-compliant installs.
- [Exterior & Landscape Lighting](https://theproperelectric.com/services/exterior-landscape-lighting.html): Low-voltage landscape lighting, security lighting, permanent holiday lighting tracks.
- [Commercial Electrical](https://theproperelectric.com/services/commercial-electrical.html): Restaurant, retail, and office tenant build-outs, code-compliant electrical, off-hours scheduling.
